content.text: MR started sending screenshots of the lineup, which I can only assume they are doing purposefully to redact additional info
I tried to misdirect them as much as I could saying “on the workout sheet posted inside the clubhouse(s)” and waited until like 10 a.m. when all the players were there to tweet it
They said something about it on a conference after I gave you the one from the first day, but I was half paying attention. That maid me perk back up though
I also think me putting that out there made them announce something
I mean, maybe not, but they had been lagging on it for like 3 days
And that was huge, so thank you for that.
I knew on Sunday night that at least Norris had it and I ran it up the ladder. I expected that would like, light a fire kinda thing
Ron BS’ed and I don’t think any of us wanted to speculate because what if that guy was there and we didn’t notice them? What if they worked out after media had to leave?
So that was huge and doubly huge for you to plant that addy seed in my head because I treated it as a math problem
Laughed at “So that was huge and doubly huge for you to plant that addy seed in my head because I treated it as a math problem”
